# Shoe Dog

By Knight.

Key takeaway: decide what not to do before deciding what to do. The audiobook narrator is excellent. Quotes I marked are in the margin, transcribe them later.

Worth rereading in a year, especially the chapter on planning. The author uses many case studies, some feel cherry-picked. Some chapters repeat the same point with new stories.

A good book for a long flight. The middle part drags, the last third makes up for it.
